ideas.pitch: A visual BPMN workflow engine that orchestrates multi-agent enterprise tasks while continuously performing automated pre-deployment risk and compliance checks.
ideas.title: BPMN-Guarded Multi-Agent Compliance Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the architectural patterns from UiPath AgentHack winning projects by integrating strict human-in-the-loop governance and process orchestration, which appeals directly to enterprise judges looking for production-grade agent reliability.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic routing proxy that dynamically updates its exemplar index via LLM-judge writebacks to optimize tool-call dispatch routing accuracy in real-time.
ideas.title: Self-Improving Semantic Router for Agentic Tool Use
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly adapts the winning architecture from the Superlinked x Qwen Hackathon, offering technical depth in routing optimization that immediately impresses judges looking for real engineering performance gains.

ideas.pitch: A dual-agent simulation environment where two autonomous agents engage in strategic negotiation games to autonomously discover deception vectors and vulnerability patterns without pre-programming.
ideas.title: Adversarial Red-Teaming Gym for Autonomous Agents
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs the self-improving adversarial AI mechanics that won the Datadog Self-Improving Agents Hack, captivating judges with emergent agent behavior and rigorous safety evaluation.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized Model Context Protocol server architecture that safely bridges disparate medical data sources to specialized clinical AI agents with strict audit trails.
ideas.title: Federated MCP Clinical Data Broker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the runner-up architecture from the MCP & AI Agents Hackathon by showcasing modular protocol standards and secure infrastructure integration that enterprise judges prioritize.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first AI code reviewer agent optimized to run locally on hardware NPUs, executing security checks and refactoring suggestions without sending source code to external servers.
ideas.title: Local NPU-Accelerated Code Guard Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds on the runner-up strategy of the Qualcomm Snapdragon Multiverse Hackathon by emphasizing hardware efficiency, data privacy, and local execution—key selling points for practical, real-world deployment.
